program_name: Bachelor in Information Technology (Mobile Wireless and Technology) (Honours)

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,750. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003090/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Credit in Mathematics at SPM level; AND At least a C (CGPA 2.0) in two (2) subjects at STPM level; OR Jayyid in STAM; OR 2.00 CGPA in Matriculation/Foundation; OR 2.50 CGPA for Diploma in Computer Science / Software Engineering / Information Technology / Information Systems / other equivalents; Diploma in Science and Technology or Business Studies with at least 2.50 CGPA may be accepted subject to rigorous internal assessment; CGPAs below 2.50 but above 2.00 may also be accepted subject to rigorous internal assessment; Credit in subjects related to computing at SPM or STPM preferred; UEC with at least a B in five (5) subjects including Mathematics.
